cohort: 111 women aged 18-65 years undergoing obstetric and/or gynecological surgeries (caesarean section/hysterectomy).
finding: Trushield NXT was superior to standard of care dressing for postoperative wound management in obstetric and gynecological surgeries, showing statistically significant improvements in ASEPSIS score, dressing time, pain scores, pain during dressing removal, and patient satisfaction.
